SampleUS.ar: زمن النظام عند أخذ هذه العينة

desc.en: Automatic Dependent Serveillance - Broadcast detected vehicle information
Aeron PLX GNSS status and accuracy (GPS_PARA + EXTD_GNSS)

FixT.en: GPS fix type as reported to AP_GPS

Epoch.en: Unix epoch seconds at sample time

desc.tr: Mikserden önceki kontrol yüzeyi komutları (kanatçık, irtifa dümeni, gaz, istikamet dümeni, flap). Otopilotun yüzeylere ne emrettiğini gösterir; RCOU ile karşılaştırarak mikser/servo sorunları bulunur.
desc.en: Control surface commands before the mixer (aileron, elevator, throttle, rudder, flaps). Shows what the autopilot commanded; compare with RCOU to find mixer/servo issues. — Normalised pre-mixer control surface outputs
desc.ar: أوامر أسطح التحكم قبل الخلّاط (الجنيحات، الرافع، الخانق، الدفة، القلابات). تُظهر ما أمر به الطيار الآلي؛ وبمقارنتها مع RCOU تُكتشف مشاكل الخلط والسيرفو.

Ail.en: Pre-mixer value for aileron output (between -4500 and 4500)
Ail.tr: Kanatçık çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (-4500 ile 4500 arası)
Ail.ar: قيمة خرج الجنيحات قبل الخلّاط (بين -4500 و 4500)

Elev.en: Pre-mixer value for elevator output (between -4500 and 4500)
Elev.tr: Irtifa dümeni çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (-4500 ile 4500 arası)
Elev.ar: قيمة خرج الرافع قبل الخلّاط (بين -4500 و 4500)

Thr.en: Pre-mixer value for throttle output (between -100 and 100)
Thr.tr: Gaz çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (-100 ile 100 arası)
Thr.ar: قيمة خرج الخانق قبل الخلّاط (بين -100 و 100)

Rudd.en: Pre-mixer value for rudder output (between -4500 and 4500)
Rudd.tr: Istikamet dümeni çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (-4500 ile 4500 arası)
Rudd.ar: قيمة خرج الدفة قبل الخلّاط (بين -4500 و 4500)

Flap.en: Pre-mixer value for flaps output (between 0 and 100)
Flap.tr: Flap çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (0 ile 100 arası)
Flap.ar: قيمة خرج القلابات قبل الخلّاط (بين 0 و 100)

Steer.en: Pre-mixer value for steering output (between -4500 and 4500)
Steer.tr: Yön kontrolü (steering) çıkışının mikser öncesi değeri (-4500 ile 4500 arası)
Steer.ar: قيمة خرج التوجيه قبل الخلّاط (بين -4500 و 4500)

SS.tr: Yüzey hareketi / hava hızı ölçekleme değeri
SS.ar: قيمة تحجيم حركة الأسطح / السرعة الجوية

desc.tr: İkincil (DCM) tutum ve konum tahmini. EKF ile büyük fark varsa sensör ya da kestirim sorunu düşünülür.

desc.ar: تقدير احتياطي (DCM) للوضعية والموقع. الفرق الكبير عن EKF يشير إلى مشكلة في الحساسات أو التقدير.

Contents of 'Base Station Report' AIS message, see: https://gpsd.gitlab.io/gpsd/AIVDM.html#_type_4_base_station_report
Contents of 'static and voyage related data' AIS message, see: https://gpsd.gitlab.io/gpsd/AIVDM.html#_type_5_static_and_voyage_related_data
Raw AIS AVDIM messages contents, see: https://gpsd.gitlab.io/gpsd/AIVDM.html#_aivdmaivdo_sentence_layer

ID.en: sequential message ID for multi-sentence messages

TimeUS.en: Timestamp of the current Attitude loop

desc.en: Angle of attack and sideslip. Used to understand stall tendency and uncoordinated turns. — Angle of attack and Side Slip Angle values
desc.ar: زاوية الهجوم وزاوية الانزلاق الجانبي. تُستخدم لفهم الميل للانهيار (Stall) والانعطافات غير المنسقة.

AOA.en: Angle of Attack calculated from airspeed, wind vector,velocity vector
AOA.tr: Hava hızı, rüzgâr ve hız vektörlerinden hesaplanan hücum açısı
AOA.ar: زاوية الهجوم المحسوبة من السرعة الجوية ومتجهي الرياح والسرعة

SSA.en: Side Slip Angle calculated from airspeed, wind vector,velocity vector
SSA.tr: Hava hızı, rüzgâr ve hız vektörlerinden hesaplanan yan kayma açısı
SSA.ar: زاوية الانزلاق الجانبي المحسوبة من السرعة الجوية ومتجهي الرياح والسرعة

desc.en: helicopter AutoRotation Head Speed (ARHS) controller information

P.en: P-term for head speed controller response

FF.en: FF-term for head speed controller response

desc.tr: Arm/disarm olayları: ne zaman, hangi yöntemle, zorlanarak mı yapıldı. Uçuş başlangıç ve bitişini belirlemenin en güvenilir yoludur.
desc.en: Arm/disarm events: when, by which method, and whether forced. The most reliable way to find flight start and end. — Arming status changes
desc.ar: أحداث التسليح ونزع التسليح: متى وبأي طريقة وهل كانت قسرية. أوثق طريقة لتحديد بداية الطيران ونهايته.

ArmState.en: true if vehicle is now armed
ArmState.tr: Araç şu an silahlı (arm) ise doğru
ArmState.ar: صحيح إذا كانت المركبة مُسلّحة (Armed) الآن

ArmChecks.en: arming bitmask at time of arming
ArmChecks.tr: Arm anındaki arm kontrol bit maskesi
ArmChecks.ar: قناع بتات فحوص التسليح لحظة التسليح

Forced.ar: صحيح إذا تم التسليح/نزع التسليح قسرياً

FF.en: Velocity to acceleration feed forward component

desc.tr: Hava hızı sensörü verileri. Pitot tıkanıklığı, kalibrasyon hatası veya sensör arızası burada görülür; sabit kanatta en kritik sensörlerden biridir.
desc.en: Airspeed sensor data. Pitot blockage, calibration error or sensor failure shows here; one of the most critical sensors on a fixed-wing.
desc.ar: بيانات حساس السرعة الجوية. يظهر هنا انسداد البيتوت أو خطأ المعايرة أو عطل الحساس؛ من أهم الحساسات في الطائرات ثابتة الجناح.

DiffPress.en: Pressure difference between static and dynamic port
DiffPress.tr: Statik ve dinamik port arasındaki basınç farkı
DiffPress.ar: فرق الضغط بين المنفذين الساكن والديناميكي

U.en: True if sensor is being used
U.ar: صحيح إذا كان الحساس قيد الاستخدام

Pri.en: Primary instance number. If equal to I then this sensor is primary sensor
Pri.tr: Birincil sensör numarası; I ile eşitse bu sensör birincildir
Pri.ar: رقم الحساس الأساسي؛ إذا ساوى I فهذا الحساس هو الأساسي

Angle.en: angle change since the start of the twitch, positive in the test direction

Rate.en: rate change since the start of the twitch, positive in the test direction

rErr.en: Roll angle error between shaped and measured

pErr.en: Pitch angle error between shaped and measured

Axis.en: which axis is currently being tuned

freq_m.en: current frequency for motor input to rate

gain_m.en: current response gain for motor input to rate

phase_m.en: current response phase for motor input to rate

freq_t.en: current frequency for target rate to rate

gain_t.en: current response gain for target rate to rate

phase_t.en: current response phase for target rate to rate

desc.tr: İstenen ve gerçekleşen tutum (yatış, yunuslama, yön). İkisi arasındaki fark ayar (tuning) kalitesini, mekanik sorunları ve kontrol kaybını gösterir.
desc.en: Desired versus achieved attitude (roll, pitch, yaw). The gap between them reveals tuning quality, mechanical problems and loss of control. — Canonical vehicle attitude
desc.ar: الوضعية المطلوبة مقابل المتحققة (الدوران، الميلان، الاتجاه). الفرق بينهما يكشف جودة الضبط والمشاكل الميكانيكية وفقدان السيطرة.

Axis.en: which axis is currently being tuned

Targ.en: target angle or rate, depending on tuning step

Min.en: measured minimum target angle or rate

Max.en: measured maximum target angle or rate

desc.tr: Yardımcı (AUX) fonksiyon tetiklemeleri: RC anahtarı veya YKİ ile hangi fonksiyonun ne zaman çalıştırıldığı.
desc.en: Auxiliary function triggers: which function was invoked when, via RC switch or GCS. — Auxiliary function invocation information
desc.ar: تفعيلات الوظائف المساعدة: أي وظيفة فُعّلت ومتى، عبر مفتاح RC أو المحطة الأرضية.

index.en: index within source. 0 indexed. Invalid for scripting.
index.tr: Kaynak içindeki sıra (0'dan başlar; betiklerde geçersiz)
index.ar: الفهرس داخل المصدر (يبدأ من 0؛ غير صالح للسكربتات)

DynPrX.en: calculated dynamic pressure in the bodyframe X-axis

DynPrY.en: calculated dynamic pressure in the bodyframe Y-axis

DynPrZ.en: calculated dynamic pressure in the bodyframe Z-axis

desc.tr: Barometre: basınç, sıcaklık ve buna dayalı irtifa. Pervane rüzgârı, güneş ısısı veya kapalı gövde basınç değişimleri irtifa hatası yaratır.
desc.en: Barometer: pressure, temperature and derived altitude. Prop wash, sun heating or enclosed-fuselage pressure changes cause altitude errors. — Gathered Barometer data
desc.ar: البارومتر: الضغط ودرجة الحرارة والارتفاع المشتق منهما. تيار المروحة أو حرارة الشمس أو تغيرات الضغط داخل الجسم تسبب أخطاء في الارتفاع.

CRt.en: derived climb rate from primary barometer
CRt.ar: معدل الصعود المشتق من البارومتر الأساسي

Offset.en: raw adjustment of barometer altitude, zeroed on calibration, possibly set by GCS
Offset.tr: Barometre irtifasının ham düzeltmesi (kalibrasyonda sıfırlanır, YKİ tarafından ayarlanabilir)
Offset.ar: التصحيح الخام لارتفاع البارومتر (يُصفّر عند المعايرة وقد تضبطه المحطة الأرضية)

GndTemp.en: temperature on ground, specified by parameter or measured while on ground
GndTemp.tr: Yerdeki sıcaklık (parametreden ya da yerdeyken ölçülen)
GndTemp.ar: درجة الحرارة على الأرض (من المعامل أو المقاسة على الأرض)

H.en: true if barometer is considered healthy

desc.tr: Batarya: gerilim, akım, tüketilen kapasite, kalan yüzde. Gerilim çökmesi ve akım sensörünün çalışıp çalışmadığı burada kontrol edilir.
desc.en: Battery: voltage, current, consumed capacity, remaining percent. Voltage sag and whether the current sensor works are checked here. — Gathered battery data
desc.ar: البطارية: الجهد والتيار والسعة المستهلكة والنسبة المتبقية. يُفحص هنا هبوط الجهد وعمل حساس التيار.

EnrgTot.en: consumed Wh, energy this battery has expended

SH.en: state of health percentage.  0 if unknown
SH.ar: نسبة صحة البطارية (0 إذا كانت غير معروفة)

Health.en: True if beacon sensor is healthy

GPSTime.en: milliseconds since start of GPS week

desc.tr: DroneCAN cihaz bilgileri (düğüm kimliği, donanım, yazılım sürümü). CAN hattındaki çevre birimlerini tanımlar.
desc.en: DroneCAN device info (node ID, hardware, software version). Identifies peripherals on the CAN bus. — Info from GetNodeInfo request
desc.ar: معلومات أجهزة DroneCAN (معرّف العقدة، العتاد، إصدار البرنامج). تحدد الأجهزة الطرفية على ناقل CAN.

VendorCode.en: vendor specific code. In AP_Periph this is available memory in bytes.

Act.en: true if the controller is switched on by the pilot

Run.en: true if the controller is actually running. Act can be true while Run is false, for example during an RC failsafe or in a flight mode the backend refuses to run in.

Id.en: Servo number this data relates to

Pow.en: Amount of rated power being applied

RMSRollP.en: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Roll Rate controller P gain

RMSRollD.en: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Roll rate controller D gain

RMSPitchP.en: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Pitch Rate controller P gain

RMSPitchD.en: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Pitch Rate controller D gain

RMSYaw.en: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Yaw Rate controller P+D gain

desc.tr: Sabit kanat kontrol ayarı: istenen/gerçekleşen yatış-yunuslama, gaz, dümen ve hava hızı. Uçağın komutları ne kadar iyi takip ettiğini gösterir.
desc.en: Fixed-wing control tuning: desired/achieved roll-pitch, throttle, rudder and airspeed. Shows how well the aircraft follows commands. — Control Tuning information
desc.ar: ضبط التحكم للطائرة ثابتة الجناح: الدوران والميلان المطلوب والمتحقق، الخانق، الدفة والسرعة الجوية. يُظهر مدى اتباع الطائرة للأوامر.

NavPitch.en: desired pitch assuming pitch trims are already applied

Pitch.en: achieved pitch assuming pitch trims are already applied,ie "0deg" is level flight trimmed pitch attitude as shown on artificial horizon level line.
Pitch.tr: Gerçekleşen yunuslama (trim uygulanmış; 0° yapay ufuktaki düz uçuştur)
Pitch.ar: الميلان الطولي المتحقق (بعد التريم؛ 0° هو الطيران الأفقي على الأفق الصناعي)

ThD.ar: الخانق المطلوب من متحكم السرعة والارتفاع (TECS)

As.en: airspeed estimate (or measurement if airspeed sensor healthy and ARSPD_USE>0)
As.tr: Hava hızı tahmini (sensör sağlıklı ve ARSPD_USE>0 ise ölçüm)
As.ar: تقدير السرعة الجوية (أو القياس إذا كان الحساس سليماً و ARSPD_USE>0)

AsT.en: airspeed type ( old estimate or source of new estimate)
AsT.tr: Hava hızı türü (eski tahmin ya da yeni tahminin kaynağı)
AsT.ar: نوع السرعة الجوية (تقدير قديم أو مصدر التقدير الجديد)

GU.en: groundspeed undershoot when flying with minimum groundspeed
GU.tr: Asgari yer hızıyla uçarken yer hızı açığı
GU.ar: نقص السرعة الأرضية عند الطيران بالحد الأدنى للسرعة الأرضية

ErrYaw.en: difference between measured yaw and DCM yaw estimate

Dp.en: Number of times we rejected a write to the backend
Dp.ar: عدد مرات رفض الكتابة إلى وحدة التخزين

RT.en: Number of blocks sent from the retry queue

RS.en: Number of resends of unacknowledged data made

Fa.en: Average number of blocks on the free list

Fmn.en: Minimum number of blocks on the free list

Fmx.en: Maximum number of blocks on the free list

Pa.en: Average number of blocks on the pending list

Pmn.en: Minimum number of blocks on the pending list

Pmx.en: Maximum number of blocks on the pending list

Sa.en: Average number of blocks on the sent list

Smn.en: Minimum number of blocks on the sent list

Smx.en: Maximum number of blocks on the sent list

desc.tr: Log yazma sistemi istatistikleri. Atlanan yazmalar logda boşluklara neden olur; SD kart yavaşsa burada görülür.
desc.en: Logging system statistics. Dropped writes cause gaps in the log; a slow SD card shows here. — Onboard logging statistics
desc.ar: إحصاءات نظام التسجيل. الكتابات المفقودة تُحدث فجوات في السجل؛ وتظهر هنا بطء بطاقة SD.

Dp.en: Number of times we rejected a write to the backend
Dp.ar: عدد مرات رفض الكتابة إلى وحدة التخزين

FMn.en: Minimum free space in write buffer in last time period
FMn.tr: Son dönemde yazma tamponundaki en az boş alan
FMn.ar: أدنى مساحة فارغة في مخزن الكتابة خلال الفترة الأخيرة

FMx.en: Maximum free space in write buffer in last time period
FMx.tr: Son dönemde yazma tamponundaki en çok boş alan
FMx.ar: أعلى مساحة فارغة في مخزن الكتابة خلال الفترة الأخيرة

FAv.en: Average free space in write buffer in last time period
FAv.tr: Son dönemde yazma tamponundaki ortalama boş alan
FAv.ar: متوسط المساحة الفارغة في مخزن الكتابة خلال الفترة الأخيرة

Travel.en: Expected travel distance vehicle will travel from this point

P.en: Deepstall steering PID Proportional response component

I.en: Deepstall steering PID Integral response component

D.en: Deepstall steering PID Derivative response component

desc.en: Status received from ESCs via Extended DShot telemetry v2

Stress.en: current stress level (commutation effort), scaled to [0..255]

MaxStress.en: maximum stress level (commutation effort) since arming, scaled to [0..15]

desc.en: Electronic Fuel Injection system data - redux
Electronic Fuel Injection data - Hirth specific Status information

ThO.en: Throttle output as received by the engine

ThM.en: Modified throttle_to_hirth output sent to the engine

desc.tr: Hata olayları: alt sistem ve hata kodu (ör. GPS kaybı, radyo failsafe, EKF hatası). Kök neden analizinin ilk baktığı mesajdır.
desc.en: Error events: subsystem and error code (e.g. GPS lost, radio failsafe, EKF failure). The first message a root-cause analysis looks at. — Specifically coded error messages
desc.ar: أحداث الأخطاء: النظام الفرعي ورمز الخطأ (مثل فقدان GPS، فشل الراديو، خطأ EKF). أول رسالة يُنظر إليها في تحليل السبب الجذري.

Subsys.en: Subsystem in which the error occurred
Subsys.ar: النظام الفرعي الذي حدث فيه الخطأ

RawRPM.en: reported motor rotation rate without slew adjustment

Volt.en: Perceived input voltage for the ESC

MotTemp.en: measured motor temperature in centi-degrees C

desc.tr: Olaylar: arm, disarm, kalkış tamamlandı, iniş tamamlandı, failsafe vb. Uçuş zaman çizelgesinin omurgasıdır.
desc.en: Events: armed, disarmed, auto takeoff complete, landing complete, failsafes etc. The backbone of the flight timeline. — Specifically coded event messages
desc.ar: الأحداث: التسليح، نزع التسليح، اكتمال الإقلاع، اكتمال الهبوط، حالات الطوارئ... وهي العمود الفقري للخط الزمني للرحلة.

NF.en: total number of active harmonic notches

CF1.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 1

CF2.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 2

CF3.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 3

CF4.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 4

CF5.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 5

CF6.en: First harmonic centre frequency for motor 6

HF1.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 1

HF2.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 2

HF3.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 3

HF4.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 4

HF5.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 5

HF6.en: Second harmonic centre frequency for motor 6

Qual.en: Flow sensor quality. If this value falls below FHLD_QUAL_MIN parameter, FlowHold will act just like AltHold.

Ix.en: Integral part of PI controller, X-Axis

Iy.en: Integral part of PI controller, Y-Axis

desc.en: Height estimation using optical flow sensor

InsH.en: Height estimate from inertial navigation library

LastInsH.en: Last used INS height in optical flow sensor height estimation calculations

DTms.en: Time between optical flow sensor updates. This should be less than 500ms for performing the height estimation calculations

desc.tr: Log içine gömülü dosya parçaları (ör. görev veya betik dosyaları).
desc.en: File chunks embedded in the log (e.g. mission or script files). — File data
desc.ar: أجزاء ملفات مضمّنة في السجل (مثل ملفات المهمة أو السكربتات).

Offset.en: Offset into the file of this block

desc.tr: Format tanımı: logdaki her mesaj türünün adı, uzunluğu ve alanları. Log okuyucunun sözlüğüdür.
desc.en: Format definition: name, length and fields of each message type in the log. The log reader's dictionary. — Message defining the format of messages in this file
desc.ar: تعريف التنسيق: اسم وطول وحقول كل نوع رسالة في السجل. قاموس قارئ السجل.

Type.en: unique-to-this-log identifier for message being defined
Type.tr: Tanımlanan mesajın bu loga özgü kimliği
Type.ar: المعرّف الفريد في هذا السجل للرسالة المُعرَّفة

Length.en: the number of bytes taken up by this message (including all headers)
Length.ar: عدد البايتات التي تشغلها الرسالة (بما فيها الترويسات)

Name.en: name of the message being defined

Format.en: character string defining the C-storage-type of the fields in this message
Format.tr: Alanların C veri tiplerini tanımlayan karakter dizisi
Format.ar: سلسلة أحرف تحدد أنواع بيانات C للحقول

Columns.en: the labels of the message being defined

desc.tr: Alanların birim ve çarpan bilgisi (FMT ile birlikte).
desc.en: Units and multipliers of fields (used with FMT). — Message defining units and multipliers used for fields of other messages
desc.ar: وحدات ومضاعفات الحقول (تُستخدم مع FMT).

FmtType.en: numeric reference to associated FMT message
FmtType.ar: مرجع رقمي إلى رسالة FMT المرتبطة

UnitIds.en: each character refers to a UNIT message.  The unit at an offset corresponds to the field at the same offset in FMT.Format
UnitIds.tr: Her karakter bir UNIT mesajını gösterir; sıra FMT.Format'taki alanla eşleşir
UnitIds.ar: كل حرف يشير إلى رسالة UNIT؛ الترتيب يطابق الحقل في FMT.Format

MultIds.en: each character refers to a MULT message.  The multiplier at an offset corresponds to the field at the same offset in FMT.Format
MultIds.tr: Her karakter bir MULT mesajını gösterir; sıra FMT.Format'taki alanla eşleşir
MultIds.ar: كل حرف يشير إلى رسالة MULT؛ الترتيب يطابق الحقل في FMT.Format

Count.en: vertex cound in polygon if applicable

desc.tr: Uçuş sırasında FFT ile ölçülen gürültü frekansları; harmonik çentik filtresi ayarı için kullanılır.
desc.en: In-flight FFT noise frequencies; used to tune the harmonic notch filter. — Filter Tuning Message - per motor
desc.ar: ترددات الضجيج المقاسة بـ FFT أثناء الطيران؛ تُستخدم لضبط مرشح الشق التوافقي.

NF1.en: desired harmonic notch centre frequency for motor 1
NF1.tr: 1. motor için istenen harmonik çentik merkez frekansı
NF1.ar: تردد مركز الشق التوافقي المطلوب للمحرك 1

NF2.en: desired harmonic notch centre frequency for motor 2
NF2.tr: 2. motor için istenen harmonik çentik merkez frekansı
NF2.ar: تردد مركز الشق التوافقي المطلوب للمحرك 2

desc.en: EKF3 variances and health (SV, SP, SH, SM test ratios, fault and timeout flags). Ratios above 1 mean measurements were rejected. — EKF3 variances.  SV, SP, SH and SM are probably best described as 'Squared Innovation Test Ratios' where values <1 tells us the measurement was accepted and >1 tells us it was rejected. They represent the square of the (innovation / maximum allowed innovation) where the innovation is the difference between predicted and measured value and the maximum allowed innovation is determined from the uncertainty of the measurement, uncertainty of the prediction and scaled using the number of standard deviations set by the innovation gate parameter for that measurement, eg EK3_MAG_I_GATE, EK3_HGT_I_GATE, etc
